title: The Tank I: Summer
transcript:
June. The heat sits on the town like a lid.
Behind the temple, the old tank: green water, stone steps, a stray dog asleep in the shade.
Mango pits in the dust. Two pairs of chappals on the top step.

RAMAN:
"Two point seven one eight, and then it keeps going. It never ends, Parth. That's why it's the best number."

PARTH:
"All numbers keep going."

RAMAN:
"Not like this one. Okay. Rules. Under for two. Up. Seven. Up. One. Up. Eight."

RAMAN:
"Whoever comes up early buys the gola."

The dog lifts its head when they jump.
